title: Build macro/micro reasoning skill
desc:

- MICRO level: identifies affected tickers, competitors, supply chain

- Config file: alert_config.json with all thresholds and settings
- CLI: alerts.py run [--dry-run], alerts.py config [--show|--add-ticker|--remove-ticker], alerts.py history, alerts.py cleanup
- Cron-friendly: returns JSON, exits cleanly

title: Implement graceful gateway shutdown with queue draining
desc:
Add graceful shutdown handler that waits for active agent runs and queued messages to complete (with timeout). Currently gateway aborts all runs immediately on restart, losing in-flight work. Should: (1) Set drain timeout (10-30s configurable), (2) Wait for FOLLOWUP_QUEUES to empty, (3) Wait for active runs to complete, (4) Hard-shutdown after timeout. Prevents data loss during deployments. Analysis at /home/debian/clawd/work/gateway-restart-analysis.md

Implemented by coding agent:
- Created src/gateway/graceful-drain.ts with drain logic
- Exposed queue accessors in src/auto-reply/reply/queue/state.ts
- Added ChatRunRegistry.size() for counting active runs
- Integrated drain into src/gateway/server-close.ts
- Updated config types and schema for gateway.shutdown.graceful
- Added unit tests in src/gateway/graceful-drain.test.ts
- Disabled by default (opt-in via config)
